pack.name: NIST AI RMF 1.0 — core outcomes
pack.jurisdiction: International voluntary use; published by NIST (United States)
coverage: top-level GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE function readiness
known_gaps: This baseline does not encode every category, subcategory or suggested action.
AI RMF 1.0 is under revision; a future release must not silently replace this pinned version.
Organisation-specific target profiles and tolerances are not supplied.
pack.notice: NIST AI RMF is voluntary. Findings are outcome gaps, not legal non-compliance.

fact_catalog.question: Are AI risk governance policies, roles and accountability defined?
Are context, intended purpose, affected people and impacts mapped?
Are risks and trustworthiness characteristics measured with documented methods?
Are prioritised risk responses owned and tracked?
Does the system use generative AI?
Has NIST AI 600-1 been considered for the generative-AI context?

anchors.summary: Voluntary framework organised around GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE and MANAGE.

anchors.source: NIST AI RMF: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
anchors.summary: Cross-sectoral profile describing generative-AI risks and suggested actions aligned to AI RMF functions.

anchors.source: NIST AI RMF official landing page
anchors.summary: NIST states that AI RMF 1.0 is being revised; this pack therefore pins 1.0.

finding.title: AI risk governance is not established
finding.summary: Policies, roles, accountability and a risk-management culture are not evidenced for the target.

obligations.title: Define the target GOVERN outcomes and evidence current practice.

finding.title: Context and impacts are not mapped
finding.summary: Intended purpose, context, affected people, benefits and harms are not sufficiently evidenced.

obligations.title: Map context and material impacts before selecting measurements and responses.

finding.title: Risk measurement is not operational
finding.summary: Documented, repeatable measurement and evaluation methods are not evidenced.

obligations.title: Select and document measurements appropriate to the mapped risks.

finding.title: Risk responses are not owned and tracked
finding.summary: Prioritised treatments, residual risks and ongoing monitoring are not evidenced.

obligations.title: Prioritise, assign and monitor risk responses against the target profile.

finding.title: Generative-AI-specific risks are not mapped to NIST AI 600-1
finding.summary: The target uses generative AI but the cross-sectoral Generative AI Profile is not evidenced in its target profile.

obligations.title: Select relevant GAI risks and actions rather than treating the profile as a binary certification.
